detection_split.method: Available Web train images deterministically split 85/15 using SHA-256 of seed 20261010 and filename; official Web test is retained unchanged.
detection_split.reason: The official Web.zip is documented as damaged and contains none of the 81 giant-panda images referenced by corrected val annotations.
detection_split.warning: This is a derived training split. Use giant_panda_subset/web for exact official split bookkeeping.

deep_panda_derivation.method: same-label adjacent AVA intervals with linear bbox interpolation
limitations: Intermediate boxes are interpolated rather than manually annotated.
Nearby video frames remain visually correlated even though train and val videos are disjoint.
Drink has only two source videos, so visual diversity remains limited.
No frame outside a same-label annotated interval is assigned a class.

classification_mapping_note: Historical crop CSV class_id differs from current training mapping. The release uses directory names and class_indices.json: drink=0,eat=1,rest=2,walk=3.
camera_note: Camera panda images are screen recaptures, not direct captures of live pandas. The capture timestamps are device clock values and not reliable calendar dates.
split_policy: Preserve existing sample split assignments exactly. Camera recaptures and online video supplements remain train-only.
